title: Bondi to Coogee
content:
The coastal walk south from Bondi: past the Icebergs pool, over the headlands to Tamarama, Bronte and Clovelly, and down to Coogee, about six kilometres of cliff path.

Demo day: the walk is a simulated route along the real path. Photographs from Wikimedia Commons, credited in each caption.
